## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves. Link related issues.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactoring
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Dependency or build configuration

## Validation

- [ ] I reviewed the changed code and checked for unintended changes.
- [ ] Node.js syntax checks and calculation tests pass (`node tests.js` and `node --test tests/*.test.cjs`).
- [ ] Python tests pass when Python code or dependencies are changed.
- [ ] PWA behavior, offline support, and responsive layout were checked when affected.
- [ ] Android packaging/build was checked when Android or Capacitor files are changed.
- [ ] Documentation was updated where necessary.

## Security and compatibility

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or personal data were added.
- [ ] Dependency changes are intentional and compatible.
- [ ] Any new permissions, external requests, or data handling are documented.
